summary: fits defers plan §4 d-confound controls (n-ladder, rp896, tier-B/length reads); verdicts stay confounded until they land; controls-present upgrade lacks the §4 sign-stability check
evidence: scripts/issue1491_ladder_fits.py:19-31 (docstring defers n-ladder, tier-B sweep, rp896, length reads, behavior companion to 'Unit 4 or a Unit-3 follow-up commit'); scripts/issue1491_ladder_contrasts.py:276-300 (_confound_status upgrades to 'controls-present' on key PRESENCE alone — plan §4 requires the Δ/ΔΓ SIGN be stable under controls (a)-(c) before a verdict is readable as a scale effect; and (c) truncation_cost_7b is satisfied by mere existence of the 7B fits JSON — the quantified 7B@25k-vs-0.754/0.760 read is never computed). Until the controls land AND the sign-stability check exists, every registered verdict must ship with the sample-efficiency-confounded qualifier on EVERY consumer surface.

summary: Gate-1 fail sentinel lacks sentinel_schema_version/kind/version - poller skips it as malformed; plan's 'epm:failure via poller' abort contract never posts. Use C.write_sentinel(task_id=1491).
evidence: scripts/issue1491_ladder_generate_capture.py:1171-1185 writes {epm_marker,failure_class,reason,detail,split,shard_index} — none of poll_pipeline.py:1331 _SENTINEL_REQUIRED_KEYS; the #899 synthesis fallback (poll_pipeline.py:1381-1384) cannot fire (filename not -results.json, no 10-key payload) so the drain logs 'missing required keys; skipping'. Gate failure then surfaces only as a shard death with no [phase=done] (launcher WARN+continue unless ALL shards fail). Fix: issue779_common.write_sentinel('epm:failure', note, task_id=1491, extra={...}) or add the three envelope keys + note payload.

summary: Gate 1 keyed on >=2000 rows PER SHARD with no end-of-shard fallback: at the documented 32B 16-shard config every train shard has ~1563 rows, so the plan-registered gate silently never fires.
evidence: issue1491_ladder_generate_capture.py:1158 (len(self_gate_rows) >= 2000) vs issue1491_ladder_launch.sh:48-56 (32B example: --num-shards 16); _shard_range(25000,16,k) gives 1562-1570 rows/shard. At 8 shards the gate fires after 4 chunks; at 16 it is unreachable, exactly on the rung the primary contrast depends on. Fix: derive the threshold as min(2000, expected_shard_rows) (the existing <500 skip in _first_chunk_self_gate still guards degenerate n), or run the gate once at end-of-shard when never fired.

summary: phase_split_capture consumes LOCAL gen raws never uploaded (SIGKILLed gen wave); a later gen resume REGENERATES those chunks at temp 1.0 - Hub raw text diverges silently from what the .pt was...
evidence: issue1491_ladder_generate_capture.py:720-740 (_load_persisted_gen_chunk: local.exists() short-circuits the done_raw check); launch.sh:299-311 exits 0 on a partially-failed gen wave, so the documented 'gen && capture' chain proceeds; gen resume (chunk_done = raw_name in done_raw, line 1002-1003) then regenerates the unflushed chunks and uploads R_new while the shipped .pt holds activations of R_old — invisible to the prompt-equality assert (responses unchecked) and to any parity gate (matched rows only). Window: <=UPLOAD_BATCH(20) chunks per SIGKILLed gen shard (SIGTERM/exceptions DO flush). Fix: in phase_split_capture treat local-present-but-not-in-done_raw as incomplete gen and fail loud unless args.no_upload; or make the gen-wave resume upload an existing local raw instead of regenerating.
